caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate chair positioned upright against a plain, light beige background. The chair features a richly detailed wooden frame with a dark brown finish; the backrest has an intricate openwork design with curved shapes and grapevine motifs, and an upholstered, oval-shaped centerpiece. Both the seat and the oval insert on the backrest are covered in a multicolored fabric with a wavy, zigzag pattern composed of muted pinks, greens, yellows, and blues. The seat is rounded and plush, and the chair’s legs are cabriole-style, each with gentle curves and ending in slight scroll feet. The artist's signature, "Charles Goodwin," is written near the bottom right corner of the drawing in small, capitalized letters.
title: Chair
